sloka: न अत्र जीवेत् मृषावादी क्रूरो वा यदि वा शठः ।नृशंसः पाप वृत्तो वा मुनिः एष तथा विधः ॥३-११-९०॥
transliteration: na atra jīvet mṛṣāvādī krūro vā yadi vā śaṭhaḥ ।nṛśaṁsaḥ pāpa vṛtto vā muniḥ eṣa tathā vidhaḥ ॥3-11-90॥

translations.english: This sage is such type that he (his spiritual power) will not allow a liar or a cruel man or a deceitful or lustful or wicked person to thrive here.
